mechanics: Target creature gains resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage for the duration.

name: Aegis Anti-Corporate Protection
description: You install a protective firewall against hostile extra-dimensional entities, spirits, and mind-control hacks.
mechanics: Target gains +2 AC and saving throws against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead, and immunity to Charm/Frightened from them.

name: Bio-Tox Antitoxin Injector
description: You inject a neutralizing anti-toxin serum that cures poisons and grants resistance to chemical toxins.
mechanics: Touch a creature to neutralize one poison affecting it. For the duration, it has advantage on saves against poison and resistance to Poison damage.

name: Bio-Filter Purifier
description: You deploy micro-filters to neutralize bio-toxins, heavy radiation, and pollutants in food and water within 5 feet.
mechanics: All non-magical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere is purified and freed of poison and disease.

name: High-Tier Cybernetic Resuscitation
description: You use trauma-surge defibrillators and neural reconstructors to revive a target that died within the last 10 days.
mechanics: Revive a dead creature that died within the last 10 days with 1 Hit Point, restoring missing limbs and organs.

name: Sub-Dermal Bio-Siphon
description: A beam of necrotic energy drains a target's muscle strength, cutting its physical attack damage in half.
mechanics: Target a creature within range. On a hit, it takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and its weapon attacks dealing Strength damage deal half damage until the spell ends.

name: Cryo-Beam Cannon
description: You fire a beam of sub-zero cryogenic fluid that freezes a target's leg joints and reduces its speed.
mechanics:
Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Cold damage and its movement speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Scaling: Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Bio-Nanite Cellular Regeneration
description: You inject a continuous stream of cellular repair nanites that restores HP every round and regrows severed limbs.
mechanics: Target regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points instantly, and 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns for 1 hour. Severed body parts are reattached or regrown.

name: Replicant Genetic Resynthesis
description: You rebuild a deceased target's physical body into a new metahuman replica body, transferring its soul into the new frame.
mechanics: Rebuild a dead creature into a new body (rolling on a metahuman heritage table to determine its new physical species).

name: Firewall Malware Scrub
description: You run a deep system antivirus scrub that purges curses, corporate tracking bugs, and malicious hacks from a target.
mechanics: At touch, all curses, malwares, and tracking bugs affecting a target or object immediately end.

name: Hard-Light Containment Sphere
description: You trap a target inside an indestructible 10-foot hard-light kinetic force sphere.
mechanics: Encloses a Large or smaller creature in an indestructible sphere of force on a failed Dexterity save. Nothing can pass through the sphere.

name: Emergency System Defenses
description: You touch a target to reinforce its saving throws with a +d4 defense buffer.
mechanics: Target adds a d4 bonus to its saving throws for the duration.

name: Full Cybernetic Reconstruction
description: You fully reconstruct a deceased target's body and neural network, reviving it even if only a scrap of DNA remains.
mechanics: Revives a dead creature that died up to 100 years ago, reconstructing missing organs, limbs, and body parts.

name: Gravitational Inversion Field
description: You invert gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder, causing enemies and unanchored objects to fall upward.
mechanics: Gravity reverses upward in a 50-foot radius cylinder. Unanchored creatures fall upward 100 feet, slamming into ceilings for falling damage.

name: Field Defibrillator Pulse
description: You discharge a high-voltage defibrillator strike directly into a target that died within the last 1 minute, reviving it with 1 HP.
mechanics: Revives a creature that died within the last 1 minute, restoring it to life with 1 Hit Point.

name: Deployable Micro-Safehouse
description: You drop a high-tensile wire upward that opens an invisible 8-person pocket safehouse in the air.
mechanics: A 50-foot rope rises into the air, leading to an invisible extra-dimensional safehouse that holds up to eight creatures.

name: Sub-Dermal Laser Beam
description: You fire a beam of bright laser light from your palm or focus that deals Radiant damage.
mechanics:
Make a ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 Radiant damage on a hit.
Scaling: Increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Aegis Hard-Light Barrier
description: You project a floating hard-light aegis shield in front of an ally, granting them a +2 AC bonus.
mechanics: A willing creature within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Thermite Cluster Launch
description: You launch three burning thermite explosive clusters that strike single or multiple targets.
mechanics:
Create three fiery bolts. Make a ranged spell attack for each bolt, dealing 2d6 Fire damage per bolt on a hit.
At Higher Levels: Fires 1 additional bolt for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Matrix Scrying Drone
description: You project an invisible wireless scrying sensor over a target anywhere in Neo-Tokyo to watch and listen to it.
mechanics: You see and hear a specific target creature on a failed Wisdom saving throw, moving a scrying sensor with it.

name: Encrypted Stash Lockbox
description: You hide a heavy gear chest in a pocket dimension, summoning or hiding it with a replica key.
mechanics: Hides a chest holding up to 12 cubic feet of gear in an extra-dimensional plane, accessible via a replica key.

name: Thermal Optics Sweep
description: Your optics switch to thermal-infrared mode, highlighting invisible targets and optical stealth cloaks within 30 feet.
mechanics: You can see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible out to 30 feet.

name: Holographic Persona Cloak
description: You project custom holographic disguises over up to six allies to disguise them as corporate guards or idols.
mechanics: Change the physical appearance of up to six willing targets for 8 hours (Charisma save to see through).

name: Wireless Audio/Text Signal
description: You transmit a 25-word encrypted text or audio message directly to a target's neural receiver anywhere in the world.
mechanics: Send a message of 25 words or less to a creature you are familiar with. It hears the message in its mind and can reply immediately.

name: Deep-Net Data Vault Stasis
description: You lock an object or target in stasis inside a digital vault, making it immune to damage, aging, and scrying.
mechanics: Target is put into suspended animation, making it immune to aging, damage, and divination magic until triggered.

name: Biological Species Overwrite
description: You rewrite a target's physical genetic structure permanently into any other metahuman species, dragon, or beast.
mechanics: Transform a target into another creature of equal or lower CR/level permanently if concentration is maintained for 1 hour.

name: Acoustic Shatter Pulse
description: You emit a loud, high-frequency sonic pulse that shatters glass, structural barriers, and deafens enemies.
mechanics: Creatures in a 10-foot sphere take 3d8 Thunder/Sonic damage on a failed Constitution save. Non-magical inorganic objects take extra damage.

name: Sub-Dermal Reactive Firewall
description: When targeted by an attack or Magic Missile, you project a hard-light energy barrier that grants a +5 AC bonus.
mechanics: In reaction to being hit by an attack, gain a +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn and immunity to Magic Missile.

name: Aegis Kinetic Barrier
description: You project a floating hard-light barrier that grants an ally a +2 AC bonus.
mechanics: Target creature within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Monofilament Weapon Coating
description: You coat a wooden staff or club in monofilament wire, allowing you to use your spellcasting stat for melee attack rolls.
mechanics: Touch a wooden weapon. For 1 minute, use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for attack/damage rolls, dealing 1d8 damage.

name: High-Voltage Taser Palm
description: You discharge a high-voltage taser strike from your palm, dealing Lightning damage and preventing reactions.
mechanics:
Make a melee spell attack (advantage if target wears metal armor). On a hit, deal 1d8 Lightning damage and target cannot take reactions.
Scaling: Increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Acoustic Muffle Field
description: You project a 20-foot sound-proof barrier that silences all gunfire, footsteps, and spoken spell code inside.
mechanics: No sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot sphere. Creatures inside are Deafened and immune to Thunder damage.

name: Holographic Decoy Display
description: You project a simple visual or audio hologram (no larger than a 15-foot cube) within range.
mechanics: Create a purely visual or auditory image up to a 15-foot cube. Physical interaction reveals it to be an illusion.

name: Hard-Light Replicant Construct
description: You fabricate an identical hard-light or bio-synthetic duplicate of a target that possesses half its stats and abilities.
mechanics: Creates an illusory duplicate of a target creature with half its maximum Hit Points that obeys your commands.

name: Subliminal Sleep Signal
description: You broadcast a soothing acoustic frequency that knocks low-tier targets unconscious in a 20-foot sphere.
mechanics: Roll 5d8; the total is how many Hit Points of creatures in a 20-foot sphere this spell can knock unconscious.

name: Cryogenic Blizzard Cloud
description: A 40-foot cylinder fills with freezing blizzard winds, blinding targets and extinguishing fires.
mechanics: Creates a 40-foot-wide, 20-foot-high cylinder of freezing snow that heavily obscures the area and deals 2d6 Cold damage.

name: Neural Reflex Delay
description: You inject a reflex-delay glitch into up to six targets, cutting their movement speed in half and removing reactions.
mechanics: Up to six targets failing a Wisdom save have speed halved, -2 AC/DEX saves, and cannot take reactions or multi-attacks.

name: Stabilization Defibrillator Ping
description: You discharge a gentle defibrillator pulse to instantly stabilize a dying target at 0 HP.
mechanics: Touch a living creature at 0 Hit Points to stabilize it.

name: Critter Neural Interlink
description: Your translator translates the vocalizations and body language of urban critters and animals.
mechanics: Comprehend and communicate verbally with beasts for the duration.

name: Cyber-Zombie Neural Interlink
description: Your neural link interrogates a corpse, asking up to five questions before its brain decays.
mechanics: Interrogate a corpse with intact vocal cords, asking up to five questions.

name: Bio-Flora Interlink
description: You query urban rooftop gardens and mutated flora to learn events that occurred in the area.
mechanics: Commune with plants within 30 feet to learn about events, creatures, and paths.

name: Pneumatic Wall-Climber Actuators
components: (a drop of pitch and a spider)
description: Pneumatic suction cups and magnetic micro-hooks allow a target to scale vertical arcology walls effortlessly.
mechanics: Target creature gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed and can move across vertical surfaces and ceilings.

name: Monofilament Trap Array
description: A 20-foot square area fills with razor-sharp monofilament tripwires that slash creatures moving through.
mechanics: Creates difficult terrain in a 20-foot square. Moving through deals 2d4 Piercing/Slashing damage for every 5 feet.

name: Aegis Hard-Light Combat Sentries
description: Three hovering hard-light sentries orbit you, striking any enemy that enters within 15 feet.
mechanics: Hard-light sentries deal 3d8 Radiant/Force damage to enemies entering within 15 feet on a failed Wisdom save.

name: Hard-Light Floating Turret
description: You manifest a hovering hard-light energy turret that shoots lasers as a bonus action.
mechanics: Create a floating spectral turret. Make a melee spell attack dealing 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Force damage as a bonus action.

name: Neuro-Toxic Gas Venter
description: A 20-foot sphere fills with foul neuro-toxic gas that causes targets to gag and become Incapacitated.
mechanics: Creates a 20-foot sphere of yellow gas. Creatures failing a Constitution save are Incapacitated on their turn.

name: Sub-Dermal Concrete Shaping
description: You instantly reshape a 5-foot cube of concrete, rock, or masonry into any form or door passageway.
mechanics: Reshape a block of stone/concrete no larger than 5 feet in any dimension into a desired shape.

name: Sub-Dermal Titanium Skin
description: A target's skin hardens into rock-hard titanium plating, granting resistance to non-magical kinetic damage.
mechanics: Target gains resistance to non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

name: Orbital Thunderstorm Array
description: A massive 360-foot hurricane storm clouds over the district, dealing torrential acid rain, lightning, and hail damage.
mechanics: Creates a massive storm. Deals 2d6 Thunder damage, 1d6 Cold damage, 10d6 Lightning damage, and 2d6 Acid damage in stages.

name: Subliminal Behavioral Override
description: You implant a compelling course of action into a target, forcing it to carry out the command.
mechanics: Implant a reasonable command into a target on a failed Wisdom save. It carries out the task for up to 8 hours.

name: Sub-Dermal Thermal Laser Beam
description: You project a 60-foot radiant laser beam from your chest focus that deals 6d8 Radiant damage each turn.
mechanics: A 60-foot line of bright light deals 6d8 Radiant damage to creatures failing a Constitution save, and blinds them.

name: Orbital Solar Flare Nova
description: A blinding 60-foot sphere of solar plasma detonates, dealing 12d6 Radiant damage and blinding all targets.
mechanics: A 60-foot sphere detonates dealing 12d6 Radiant damage to creatures failing a Constitution save, and blinding them.

name: Mag-Lock Trap / System Glyph
description: You etch a deadly security glyph on a surface that triggers Death, Discord, Fear, Hopelessness, Insanity, Pain, or Sleep.
mechanics: Inscribe a master glyph that triggers devastating status effects in a 60-foot sphere when activated.

name: Hard-Light Hydraulic Tether
description: A hard-light kinetic beam grabs a creature or 5,000 lb object, lifting or throwing it across the field.
mechanics: Move a creature or object weighing up to 5,000 lbs up to 30 feet in any direction on a failed Strength save.

name: Encrypted Sub-Net Channel
description: You establish a private 8-way encrypted telepathic channel across all team members.
mechanics: Link up to eight willing creatures telepathically across any distance on the same plane.

name: Matrix Transit Network Shift
description: You instantly phase your team through the global transit grid to any known location.
mechanics: Teleport yourself and up to eight willing creatures to a destination you are familiar with.

name: Transit Grid Node Circle
description: You link a local chalk/digital circle to a permanent transit node anywhere in Neo-Tokyo.
mechanics: Opens a 1-round portal linking your current circle to a permanent teleportation circle elsewhere.

name: Digital Hologram Utility
description: You project minor digital glimmers, loud synth horns, or flickering lights to distract targets.
mechanics: Create three minor sensory effects (booming voice, flickering lights, minor tremors, or sparks).

name: Acoustic Shockwave Pulse
description: A 15-foot blast of sonic shockwave force pushes enemies back 10 feet and shatters windows.
mechanics: Each creature in a 15-foot cube takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away on a failed Constitution save.

name: Quantum System Lag
description: You freeze global time and digital streams around you for 1d4 + 1 rounds, taking actions freely.
mechanics: Briefly stop time for 1d4 + 1 turns, during which you can move and act while all other creatures are frozen.

name: Deployable Micro-Bunker
description: You deploy a 10-foot hard-light opaque security dome that holds up to nine allies safely.
mechanics: Creates an impenetrable 10-foot dome that holds up to nine creatures. The interior is climate-controlled.

name: Neural Linguistic Translator
description: You upload a universal translation script into a target, allowing it to understand all languages.
mechanics: Target understands any spoken language it hears and can speak any language fluently for 1 hour.

name: Bio-Flora Transit Bypass
description: You step into a living bio-plant and teleport out of another plant anywhere on the continent.
mechanics: Step into a Large or larger plant and exit from another plant of the same kind anywhere on the same plane.

name: Rooftop Bio-Flora Jump
description: You step into a living plant and teleport up to 500 feet to another plant as a bonus action.
mechanics: Use 10 feet of movement to enter a plant and teleport to another plant within 500 feet once per turn.

name: Biomass Rewrite Protocol
description: You rewrite a target's physical code, mutating it permanently into any creature or object.
mechanics: Transform a creature into any other creature or object permanently if concentration is held for 1 hour.

name: Executive Cloning Resuscitation
description: You revive a target that died up to 200 years ago, constructing a brand new flawless body.
mechanics: Restores a creature to life that died up to 200 years ago with full Hit Points and no missing body parts.

name: Sub-Dermal Sensor Scan
description: Your optics gain True Sight out to 120 feet, seeing through illusions, stealth cloaks, and matrix shifts.
mechanics: Gain True Sight out to 120 feet for 1 hour, seeing through illusions, darkness, and secret doors.

name: Sub-Dermal Targeting Paint
description: Your HUD tags a target, granting you advantage on your next attack roll.
mechanics: Gain advantage on your next attack roll against a target before the end of your next turn.

name: Hard-Light Automation Unit
description: You manifest an invisible hard-light drone that performs mundane tasks like cleaning, carrying gear, and pouring drinks.
mechanics: Creates an invisible, unaligned force construct with STR 2 that performs simple physical chores.

name: Bio-Nanite Life Drain
description: You touch a target and siphon its life force, dealing Necrotic damage and healing yourself for half.
mechanics: Make a melee spell attack dealing 3d6 Necrotic damage, healing yourself for half the damage dealt.

name: Subliminal Sonic Mockery
description: You broadcast a sting of acoustic insults directly into a target's ear implant, dealing Psychic damage and giving disadvantage on its next attack.
mechanics:
Target failing a Wisdom save takes 1d4 Psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
Scaling: Damage increases by 1d4 at 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Hard-Light Napalm Barrier
description: A 60-foot wall of roaring plasma fire erupts, burning creatures that pass through.
mechanics: Creates a wall of fire up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. Passing through deals 5d8 Fire damage.

name: Hard-Light Kinetic Wall
description: An indestructible wall of hard-light force blocks physical attacks, bullets, and spells.
mechanics: Creates an invisible, indestructible wall of force up to 10 10x10 foot panels. Nothing can pass through.

name: Cryogenic Glitch Barrier
description: A 60-foot wall of solid ice blocks physical movement and deals Cold damage when shattered.
mechanics: Creates a wall of ice up to 10 10x10 foot panels with 30 HP per panel. Breaching a panel deals 10d6 Cold damage.

name: Sub-Dermal Concrete Rampart
description: A 60-foot wall of solid reinforced concrete erupts from the pavement to provide cover.
mechanics: Creates a wall of solid stone up to 6 10x10 foot panels with 30 HP per panel.

name: Monofilament Razor Wall
description: A wall of razor-sharp monofilament tripwires and carbon thorns slashes creatures attempting to cross.
mechanics: Creates a wall of monofilament thorns up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, dealing 7d8 Piercing/Slashing damage to creatures entering.

name: Shared Damage Firewall
description: You link your protective AC and saving throw bonuses to an ally, splitting incoming damage between you.
mechanics: Target gains +1 AC and saving throws, and takes half damage from attacks, with you taking the other half.

name: Sub-Dermal Gills & Hydro-Filters
description: You grant up to ten willing allies sub-dermal gill filters that allow them to breathe underwater.
mechanics: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to breathe underwater for 24 hours.

name: Hydro-Repulsor Surface Treaders
description: You activate magnetic repulsor soles that allow up to ten allies to run across water surfaces.
mechanics: Up to ten willing creatures gain the ability to move across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground.

name: High-Tensile Cable Web
description: A massive 20-foot cube of sticky monofilament cables traps and restrains creatures.
mechanics: Fills a 20-foot cube with sticky web cables. Creatures entering must succeed on a Dexterity save or be Restrained.

name: Neural Hallucinatory Overload
description: You flood all targets in a 30-foot sphere with terrifying neural illusions that deal 10d10 Psychic damage per turn.
mechanics: Targets in a 30-foot sphere take 10d10 Psychic damage on a failed Intelligence save and become Frightened.

name: Aerosolized Cloud Flight
description: You convert up to ten willing creatures into gaseous mist clouds that fly at 300 feet per round.
mechanics: Up to ten willing creatures transform into gaseous mist clouds with a flying speed of 300 feet for 8 hours.

name: Acoustic Deflection Barrier
description: A 50-foot wall of high-pressure acoustic wind deflects ranged attacks and pushes creatures back.
mechanics: Creates a wall of high-pressure wind 50 feet long, 15 feet high that deflects ranged attacks and forces flying creatures back.

name: Quantum Matrix Alteration
description: You alter reality itself by rewriting the core digital source code of the universe to grant any desired spell effect.
mechanics: The ultimate spell. Duplicates any 8th-level or lower spell instantly without components, or alters reality at severe risk.

name: Emergency Extraction Beacon
description: You and up to five allies instantly teleport to a pre-designated safehouse or medical extraction point.
mechanics: Instantly teleports you and up to five willing creatures to a sanctuary location designated when you last rested.

name: Biometric Truth Scanner
description: You project an acoustic truth-field that prevents creatures inside a 15-foot sphere from speaking deliberate lies.
mechanics: Creatures in a 15-foot sphere failing a Charisma save cannot tell a deliberate lie while inside the area.
